description: Japan Customs import tariff lines for an HS heading or subheading (e.g. 8703 or 8703.21) from the official chapter table: description, general tariff rate, temporary rate, WTO rate and unit. Only the English chapter page for the 2026-04-01 schedule is used; the chapter table is decoded from Shift_JIS. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
